criteria.deficiency: Shared caveat (also present in the reference, so not a patch-specific failure): Task.finished now means 'finished_time latched by update/advance', not 'completed >= total'. Consequences: add_task(total=10, completed=10) and reset(completed>=total) never latch (no finished_time assignment in add_task or reset; progress.py:869 only clears it), so those tasks do not report finished until a later update/advance. A total=0 task is also not finished on creation, where the original reported finished. Also, the demo in process_renderables (progress.py:1080) is not extended with TimeElapsedColumn as the reference does, and the reference's extra changes (markup, color, console, version bump) are not part of this feature.
